options.label: Next open installment
options.description: Earliest unpaid row (scheduled/partial/late). Mirrors oldest-first; the form lets the admin adjust shares + date, and overpayment cascades to later rows. Hide the button if nothing is open. (Recommended)

options.label: Earliest row always
options.description: Always open on schedule row #1 (the earliest installment) regardless of paid status. Simpler but may land on an already-paid row.

options.label: List rows to pick first
options.description: Button goes to a small list of open installments first, admin clicks one to open its create-payment page. More clicks, more code.
